lineage_grid: For each of three seeds: CVAE-acquisition and fixed-bank-mutation acquisition, with q16 unit, q128 unit and q128 fraction20. Start each from its own round-one terminal checkpoint and training data; no-new-data control continues its own round-one terminal checkpoint on unchanged H0.
acquisition: New round-specific namespace; 256 LOW-request attempts per count; up to 16 or 128 novel unique UMA labels per count. All 18 stages are frozen before oracle scoring.
nesting: The CVAE q16 and q128 models have already diverged and are not expected to propose nested masks in round two. The fixed-bank mutation q16/q128 arms share literal seed, swap count and edit uniforms in the new namespace; q16 is an eligible prefix where common history applies.
weight: Append unit weights for unit arms. Reapply target new-row fraction .2 by measured energy-bin/count for fraction20 arms; report that prior weighted acquisitions remain in the base and audit cumulative weight concentration.
training: Same 1000-update warm-start training, optimizer/RNG/update-clock reset, fixed schema and original H0 validation selection as round one; record terminal and validation-selected weights.
assessment: Freeze a new common assessment history and namespace after round-two proposals and before new assessment draws; evaluate distinct novel yield, low-tail, actual teacher queries, UMA/MACE transfer and per-seed contrasts. Do not use round-one outcome to change this grid.
scope: Same fixed parent, teacher context and no new DFT/MD or potential fine-tuning.
